title: Forbidden Mountain
summary: On the Forbidden Mountain Wang Lin follows quietly behind the Six Desire Devil Lord, the restriction master who has studied restrictions for a thousand years and is breaking a path up the mountain while leaving new traps behind. Breaking the restrictions by force would kill a Core Formation cultivator, so Wang Lin studies them slowly, using Xu Liguo to test each one. After seven years he finds that the formation eyes are made of divine sense, and learns to break restrictions with his divine sense instead of spirit energy. Months later he is sure he can do whatever the Six Desire Devil Lord can do. Duanmu Ji arrives and smashes upward by force, sure the mountain cannot stop him since he crossed it a thousand years ago, and finds a thunder restriction that someone has tampered with. As Duanmu Ji closes in, Wang Lin hides in a fog that no divine sense can see through, after making Xu Liguo cough up the souls he refined to shield against the Soul Formation cultivators' senses.
